hints.title: Identifying Extremes
hints.text: Find the minimum and maximum values present in nums in a single pass.

hints.title: Euclidean Reduction
hints.text: Apply the Euclidean algorithm to compute the greatest common divisor between the minimum and maximum.

hints.title: Modulo Loop Termination
hints.text: Repeatedly replace (a, b) with (b, a % b) until b becomes 0, at which point a is the result.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: A, B: minimum and maximum elements in nums
complexity.notes: Linear scan to find min/max followed by logarithmic Euclidean reduction.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all divisors down from the minimum takes O(min(A, B)) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Euclidean modulo steps compute the greatest common divisor in logarithmic time with zero extra space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should find min and max in O(N) and utilize Euclidean reduction.
